name: Dickenson County, VA
findings: Dickenson County has 17 nonprofit organizations. 5 of them (29%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 5 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, Dickenson County has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Dickenson County list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 70% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 7 organizations here; 41% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?
